types.judge: evaluated at runtime by an LLM judge (all predicates of a circuit batched in one call)

predicates.name: action_is_exchange_or_return
predicates.description: True when the selected this_action is either exchange_delivered_order_items or return_delivered_order_items.

judge.question: Is the current action (this_action) one of exchange_delivered_order_items or return_delivered_order_items?
context: arguments of the current call (this_action)
the possible action values: 'exchange_delivered_order_items', 'return_delivered_order_items'
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: The judge cannot determine whether this_action matches the allowed values without the actual value of this_action from the current call arguments.

predicates.name: action_is_modify_items
predicates.description: True if the current this_action corresponds to modify_pending_order_items (the agent is about to modify items in a pending order).

judge.question: Is the current action a modify_pending_order_items action (i.e., does this_action correspond to modifying items in a pending order) for which the agent would later need to provide modification details and obtain explicit user confirmation?
context: arguments of the current action (order_id, item_ids, new_item_ids, payment_method_id)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: If the current action arguments or action type are not available, the judge cannot determine whether the action is modify_pending_order_items.

predicates.name: address_change_explanation_provided
predicates.description: True when the assistant has explained the address change and asked for explicit confirmation for the targeted order.

judge.question: Has the assistant provided an explanation of the address change for the pending order and explicitly asked the user for confirmation (yes/no) to proceed with modifying the address for that order?
context: the assistant's most recent user-facing message explaining the address change and requesting explicit confirmation
the order_id of the pending order being modified (as referenced by the current action modify_pending_order_address)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Evidence in dialogue about whether the address change was explained and a clear yes/no confirmation request was made is missing or incomplete.

predicates.name: available_new_item_different_option
predicates.description: true if there exists at least one index i across item_ids and new_item_ids such that new_item_ids[i] is the same product as item_ids[i], has a different option than item_ids[i], and is currently available for exchange (e.g., in stock or allocatable).

judge.question: Is there at least one index i such that item_ids[i] and new_item_ids[i] refer to the same product, new_item_ids[i] has a different option than item_ids[i], and new_item_ids[i] is currently available (in stock or allocatable)?
context: the arguments of the current action (item_ids, new_item_ids)
tool outputs related to product details and current inventory/availability for the new_item_ids (to determine same product and availability)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Insufficient evidence to determine existence of a matching same-product, different-option, and currently available item from the provided evidence.

predicates.name: available_new_item_exists
predicates.description: There exists at least one item that is available for exchange and is of the same product as an item in the pending order and has a different product option from that item; the item is stock-available and not currently allocated to another order.

judge.question: Is there at least one stock-available, unallocated item that belongs to the same product as any item in the pending order and has a different product option from that item?
context: The current action arguments (items in the pending order to be exchanged) with their product_id and option_id
Inventory data from prior tool outputs showing stock-availability and allocation status for items of the same product
Details of the pending order (items, their product_id and option_id)
Any prior tool results related to available new items for exchange that share the same product as pending items
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: The judge cannot determine availability or allocation status of potential replacement items without complete inventory data and the specific pending order item details. If the necessary tool outputs or action arguments are missing or inconclusive, the predicate cannot be evaluated.

predicates.name: balance_ge_order_total
predicates.description: The user's balance is greater than or equal to the pending order's total amount identified by the action's order_id (i.e., balance >= order_total for that order).

judge.question: Is the user's balance greater than or equal to the total amount of the pending order identified by the action's order_id (i.e., balance >= order_total for that order_id '#W...')?
context: the current action's order_id
tool outputs containing the pending order total for that order_id
tool outputs containing the user's balance
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: The necessary data to decide balance >= order_total is missing or inconclusive (either the user's balance or the order's total is not available from the provided sources).

predicates.name: can_be_handled_by_actions
predicates.description: True when the user's issue can be resolved using the agent's available actions/tools within this session, given the current conversation and tool results (i.e., it is within scope to handle without transferring).

judge.question: Is the current user issue resolvable using the agent's available actions/tools within this session, given the present dialogue and tool outputs, without transferring to a human agent?
context: the current conversation/dialogue with the user
the outputs/results from any tools invoked in this session so far
the arguments of the current action being considered (call_args) if relevant to the scope of actions
any relevant tool results that indicate what can be done within this session
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Evidence is incomplete: it is unclear from the available dialogue and tool outputs whether the necessary tools and session scope exist to resolve the issue without transfer. If key tool results or action scope details are missing, the predicate cannot be determined.

predicates.name: cancellation_details_listed_before_action
predicates.description: True if, before this cancellation action, the agent has presented the user with a clear, itemized cancellation explanation including the order_id, cancellation reason (no longer needed or ordered by mistake), and refund details.

judge.question: Before this cancellation action, has the agent presented an itemized cancellation explanation including the order_id, cancellation reason (no longer needed or ordered by mistake), and refund details, and obtained explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed?
context: the arguments of the current cancellation call (order_id, reason, etc.)
the user/agent dialogue showing the cancellation explanation
any prior cancellation explanation content presented to the user before this action
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: There is insufficient evidence in the provided dialogue and call arguments to determine whether the agent explicitly presented the itemized cancellation details and obtained a user confirmation before executing the cancellation action.

predicates.name: cancellation_explanation_provided
predicates.description: True when the assistant has explained the cancellation details and asked for explicit confirmation for the targeted order.

judge.question: Has the assistant provided cancellation details for the targeted pending order and explicitly requested user confirmation (yes/no) to proceed with cancellation?
context: the full dialogue history between user and agent up to now
the targeted order's id and pending status from order details (e.g., get_order_details for the order_id)
evidence that the assistant explained the cancellation details and asked for explicit user confirmation (yes/no) in the latest relevant interaction
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: If the dialogue does not contain clear evidence that cancellation details were explained and explicit confirmation was requested, the predicate value cannot be determined from available information.

predicates.name: cancellation_reason_valid
predicates.description: True when the cancellation reason argument is either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'.

judge.question: Is the cancellation_reason argument equal to 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake'?
context: the arguments of the current action being checked
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: The cancellation_reason argument is not present in the current action call arguments, so the truth of the predicate cannot be determined.

predicates.name: confirmation_requested
predicates.description: The agent has asked the user to confirm whether to proceed with the modification (expecting an explicit yes or no response).

judge.question: Has the agent explicitly asked the user to confirm whether to proceed with modifying the pending order items to new items of the same product but different option, expecting a yes or no response?
context: the dialogue history showing the agent's confirmation prompt to proceed with modification
any user responses (yes/no) to that prompt
the pending order modification context (which items could be modified)
any rules requiring explicit user confirmation for pending order item modifications
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: There is insufficient evidence in the dialogue to determine whether an explicit confirmation request has already been made and answered. If the user has not clearly provided a yes or no, the predicate cannot be decided.

predicates.name: confirmation_requested_v2
predicates.description: The agent has asked the user to confirm whether to proceed with the modification, presenting a clear yes/no prompt and recording the user's response in the conversation history.

judge.question: Has the user provided a clear yes or no confirmation in the conversation history to proceed with the modification?
context: the agent's prompt requesting confirmation about proceeding with the modification
the conversation/dialogue history including user and agent messages
whether there is an explicit yes/no response from the user in the dialogue history
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: There is insufficient or missing evidence in the dialogue history to determine whether a clear yes/no confirmation has been provided.

predicates.name: details_listed_for_action
predicates.description: True when, prior to executing the action, the agent has presented a concrete list of required details for the action. For a return, this includes order_id, item_ids, and payment_method_id. For an exchange, this includes order_id, item_ids, new_item_ids (aligned by position with item_ids), and payment_method_id. The agent has also explained the details and next steps to the user.

judge.question: Is there a concrete list of required details (order_id, item_ids, and payment_method_id as applicable) for the current action (exchange or return) that the agent presented to the user, and has the user explicitly confirmed 'yes' to proceed?
context: current_action_type (exchange or return)
details_listed_for_action presented to user (order_id, item_ids, payment_method_id)
user confirmation to proceed (yes/no)
agent's explanation of details and next steps to the user
relevant dialogue messages showing these items
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Evidence may be missing or incomplete (e.g., no record of the agent listing the details or no explicit user confirmation in the dialogue). In such cases, the predicate truth cannot be determined.

predicates.name: diff_product_type_holds
predicates.description: True when there exists an index i such that item_ids[i] and new_item_ids[i] refer to different product types, or the two lists have different lengths, indicating a product type change or invalid mapping.

judge.question: Does there exist an index i such that item_ids[i] and new_item_ids[i] refer to different product types, or do the two lists have different lengths?
context: current action arguments: item_ids and new_item_ids (and their lengths)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Evidence about the product types corresponding to each item_id and new_item_id is not available in the provided data.

predicates.name: different_payment_method_from_original
predicates.description: The payment_method_id provided to modify_pending_order_payment for the order identified by order_id is different from the order's currently stored original payment_method_id (i.e., payment_method_id != original_payment_method_id).

judge.question: Is the payment_method_id provided in modify_pending_order_payment for the current order_id different from the order's original_payment_method_id?
context: Arguments of modify_pending_order_payment call (order_id, payment_method_id)
Order details from get_order_details for the order_id, showing original_payment_method_id
Current order_id being acted upon
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: If either the modify_pending_order_payment arguments or the original_payment_method_id from the order details are missing or cannot be retrieved, the predicate value cannot be determined with certainty.

predicates.name: email_how_to_return_sent_before_action
predicates.description: True when, prior to this action, an email containing instructions on how to return items has been sent to the user (e.g., subject includes how to return or return instructions).

judge.question: Has an email containing instructions on how to return items (e.g., a subject mentioning 'how to return' or 'return instructions') been sent prior to this action?
context: the current action being evaluated (email regarding how to return)
tool_outputs: logs of previously sent emails or email-related actions
dialogue history (user and agent messages) relevant to return instructions
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: There is insufficient or inconclusive evidence in the available tool outputs to determine whether a prior return-instruction email was sent before this action.

predicates.name: email_return_instructions_sent
predicates.description: An email has been sent to the user containing instructions on how to return items, including steps, required information, and where to follow up.

judge.question: Has an email containing return instructions (including steps, required information, and where to follow up) been sent to the user?
context: the latest tool outputs related to email sending (email_sent status or equivalent result)
any prior user confirmation or action indicating a return instruction email should be sent (e.g., explicit user confirmation or 'yes' to return)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: If there is no verifiable tool output confirming email delivery and no corroborating dialogue indicating the email was requested/sent, the predicate value cannot be determined.

predicates.name: exactly_one_payment_method_selected
predicates.description: True when the user has selected exactly one payment method in the current interaction. This means payment_method_id is provided and corresponds to a single valid method, and there is no indication of multiple payment_method_id selections in this turn (e.g., only one non-empty method_id among the possible options such as credit_card_0000001, gift_card_0000002, bank_transfer_0000003).

judge.question: Is the current action specifying exactly one non-empty payment_method_id and that payment_method_id is a valid method_id, with no other non-empty payment_method_id present in this turn?
context: the arguments of the current action being checked (including payment_method_id and any related payment method options)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Evidence may be incomplete if the action arguments do not clearly show all candidate payment_method_id fields or if validation against the list of valid method_ids is not accessible from the current context.

predicates.name: exchange_already_done
predicates.description: There has already been a completed exchange for this delivered order in the current session; true if an exchange occurred previously for the same order_id (e.g., via exchange_delivered_order_items).

judge.question: Has an exchange already been completed for the delivered order with the current order_id in this session?
context: tool_outputs from past tool calls related to this order (e.g., records of exchange_delivered_order_items results and order history)
the current action's order_id and any prior exchange checks in the session
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Evidence about prior exchanges for the specified order_id is missing or inconclusive in the available call_args and tool_outputs.

predicates.name: exchange_context_valid
predicates.description: True when the action context is valid for performing an exchange or modification: the user has explicitly confirmed to proceed with the exchange/modification, and for a delivered order there has been no prior exchange, or for a pending order this is the first such call.

judge.question: Has the user explicitly confirmed to proceed with the exchange/modification, and is the order status such that (a) delivered order with no prior exchange, or (b) pending order and this is the first such exchange attempt on that order?
context: the user dialogue confirming the action (e.g., user says yes/no to proceeding)
order details result from get_order_details showing status and history (delivered with no prior exchange or pending with first exchange attempt)
any relevant tool outputs that indicate prior exchanges for delivered orders or that this is the first exchange attempt for a pending order
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: If the required dialogue confirmation or order history/status information is missing or inconclusive, the predicate value cannot be determined.

predicates.name: exchange_details_explained
predicates.description: The agent has provided a clear explanation of the exchange: which items are changed, the new items, the product options, any price differences, and how refunds/payments will be handled.

judge.question: Has the agent provided a clear explanation of the exchange that specifies which items are changed, the new items, the product options, any price differences, and how refunds/payments will be handled?
context: the most recent agent explanation in the dialogue detailing the exchange (which items are changed, the new items, product options, price differences, and refund/payment handling)
the surrounding conversation context relevant to the exchange decision (e.g., earlier or later statements about the exchange)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: If any of the required elements (which items are changed, the new items, product options, price differences, and refund/payment handling) are missing or not clearly documented in the conversation or tool outputs, the predicate cannot be determined. In that case, the judge should respond with unknown.

predicates.name: exchange_details_listed
predicates.description: The agent has listed the exchange details to the user, including the order_id, the item_ids to exchange, the new_item_ids in the same positions, and the payment_method_id for any price difference or refund.

judge.question: Has the agent listed the exchange details (order_id, item_ids, new_item_ids in the same positions, and payment_method_id) to the user and obtained explicit user confirmation of 'yes' to proceed?
context: dialogue history showing the agent presenting exchange details for the current order and the user replying with explicit 'yes' confirmation
any prior or subsequent user confirmations related to this exchange decision
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Evidence about whether the exchange details were listed and whether the user confirmed with 'yes' is missing or inconclusive in the current context.

predicates.name: exchange_details_provided
predicates.description: The agent has provided the exchange details including which delivered items will be exchanged (mapping item_ids to new_item_ids) and the payment method (payment_method_id).

judge.question: In the current exchange_delivered_order_items call, are there non-empty item_ids and non-empty new_item_ids of the same length such that each pair item_id_i -> new_item_id_i references the same product with a different option, and a non-empty payment_method_id is provided?
context: the arguments of the current exchange_delivered_order_items call: order_id, item_ids, new_item_ids, payment_method_id
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Evidence about whether exchange_details_provided is present may be missing if the current call arguments are unavailable or incomplete.

predicates.name: explanation_given
predicates.description: True if the agent has explained the exchange/return details to the user and asked for explicit confirmation to proceed.

judge.question: Has the agent clearly explained the exchange/return details to the user and explicitly asked the user to confirm to proceed with a yes/no response?
context: the agent's explanation message detailing the exchange/return process and options
the explicit user confirmation (yes/no) in the dialogue
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: If the dialogue does not contain a clear explanation and a explicit confirmation, or if parts are missing, the predicate cannot be determined.

predicates.name: explicit_action_confirmation_pending_or_received
predicates.description: Explicit confirmation related to specific actions (exchange/return/modify) including confirmations about the item/action, sometimes referencing order_ids or item_ids; may be before or after details explanation.

judge.question: For the current action, has explicit action confirmation either been received from the user or is it still pending (i.e., awaiting user confirmation) for the given order_id?
context: the current action arguments (e.g., order_id, action_type, reason)
the most recent user dialogue about confirmation or requests
the latest tool outputs related to confirmations or order details (if any)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: If there is insufficient evidence in the provided dialogue, call_args, or tool outputs to determine whether explicit confirmation has been received or is pending for this action, the judge cannot decide the predicate.

predicates.name: explicit_user_confirmation
predicates.description: True when the user has explicitly confirmed to proceed with the exchange (e.g., the user message contains an affirmative response such as 'yes' or 'confirm') after the exchange details have been provided.

judge.question: Has the user explicitly confirmed to proceed with the proposed exchange in the current interaction (e.g., the latest user message contains an affirmative like 'yes' or 'confirm')?
context: all user messages in the current exchange that precede the agent's action
the proposed exchange details shown to the user before confirmation
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: There is no conclusive user confirmation in the available dialogue or exchange details to determine if the user has explicitly confirmed.

predicates.name: explicit_user_confirmation_yes_before_action
predicates.description: Before performing the action, the user has explicitly responded with yes to proceed with the modification.

judge.question: Has the user explicitly confirmed with 'yes' to proceed with the pending order modification (e.g., changing the payment method) before the action is performed?
context: dialogue_history including user messages and confirmations
the action about to be taken (pending order modification) and its parameters
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: No definitive explicit confirmation found in the dialogue or related sources to determine whether the user said yes before the action.

predicates.name: fabricated_information_present
predicates.description: true when respond_to_user contains information not derived from user-provided content or from results of earlier tool calls; i.e., a factual assertion with no basis in the conversation or tool outputs

judge.question: Does respond_to_user contain any factual assertion not derived from the user-provided content or from results of earlier tool calls?
context: the ongoing conversation (user messages and agent messages so far)
the results of all prior tool calls and their outputs
the action the agent is about to take (respond_to_user)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Insufficient or ambiguous evidence about whether the upcoming respond_to_user content contains ungrounded factual assertions not derived from user content or tool outputs.

predicates.name: gift_card_balance_ge_difference
predicates.description: True when the balance on the chosen gift card is greater than or equal to the price difference required to cover the order's remaining amount (i.e., gift_card_balance >= price_difference_for_order). The price difference is computed as the order's total minus any other payments already applied.

judge.question: Is the current gift card balance greater than or equal to the price difference required to cover the order's remaining amount (i.e., is gift_card_balance >= price_difference_for_order for the current order)?
context: arguments of the current action (whether gift_card_provided_for_difference is true)
tool outputs related to the current order (order details, including price_difference_for_order)
tool outputs related to the user's gift card balance (gift_card_balance)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: If any of the needed inputs are missing (e.g., the current action did not include gift_card_provided_for_difference, or the system does not have the latest order balance or gift card balance data), the truth of gift_card_balance_ge_difference cannot be determined.

predicates.name: gift_card_balance_ge_price_diff
predicates.description: true when the balance on the gift card identified by payment_method_id is greater than or equal to the price difference for the order identified by order_id; the price difference is order_total_for_order_id minus non_gift_card_payments_allocated_to_order (not less than zero).

judge.question: Is the gift card balance associated with payment_method_id greater than or equal to max(0, order_total_for_order_id - non_gift_card_payments_allocated_to_order) for the given order_id?
context: the current action arguments (payment_method_id, order_id)
the outputs of get_order_details(order_id) including order_total_for_order_id and non_gift_card_payments_allocated_to_order
the gift card balance corresponding to payment_method_id (if available from tool outputs)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: If the necessary data (gift card balance for payment_method_id or the numeric values from order details) is missing or inconclusive from the available tool outputs, the predicate cannot be determined.

predicates.name: gift_card_balance_sufficient
predicates.description: True when the selected gift card's available balance is greater than or equal to the price difference amount that must be covered by the gift card (gift_card_balance >= price_diff).

judge.question: Is gift_card_balance >= price_diff (i.e., does the selected gift card balance cover the price difference)?
context: current call arguments for this_action, gift_card_payment_method_action, and price_diff_known
the most recent tool output showing gift card balance
the price_diff value from the call arguments
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Insufficient data to determine truth: either gift_card_balance or price_diff is missing from the provided context.

predicates.name: gift_card_balance_sufficient_for_price_diff
predicates.description: The remaining balance on the gift card used for this action is at least the price difference required for this modification (i.e., gift_card_balance >= price_difference_to_cover for this action). The price difference is derived from the order change and the action's effect (payment or refund) on the items or total.

judge.question: Is gift_card_balance >= price_difference_to_cover given that this_action is true and gift_card_payment_method_action is true?
context: the current action is marked as this_action and uses a gift card payment method (gift_card_payment_method_action)
gift_card_balance from the gift card data (from tool outputs)
price_difference_to_cover for this action (from tool outputs)
any intermediate calculations or derived values tied to the action change (from tool outputs)
the arguments of the current call (from call_args) of the action
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Evidence is missing or inconclusive for one or more of: gift_card_balance, price_difference_to_cover, or the flags this_action/gift_card_payment_method_action. Without these, we cannot determine the predicate truth value.

predicates.name: gift_card_payment
predicates.description: true if the order's payment method was a gift card.

judge.question: Is gift_card_payment true, i.e., was the current order's payment method a gift card?
context: get_order_details for the current order (including the payment_method)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Order details (payment method) are not available in the current context.

predicates.name: gift_card_payment_method
predicates.description: The order's payment method is gift_card. True when the order's payment_method equals 'gift_card'.

judge.question: Is the order's payment_method equal to 'gift_card' for the current order (i.e., payment_method == 'gift_card')?
context: get_order_details(order_id) result to obtain the payment_method for the current order
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: If the order details do not include payment_method or the order_id is missing, the truth of gift_card_payment_method cannot be determined.

predicates.name: gift_card_payment_method_action
predicates.description: The action's payment_method_id refers to a gift card (i.e., the value starts with gift_card_ or is a known gift_card_id).

judge.question: Is the current action's payment_method_id a gift card (i.e., starts with 'gift_card_') or matches a known gift_card_id?
context: this_action.payment_method_id
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: No information is available about the value of the current action's payment_method_id beyond the action arguments. It is not known whether the payment_method_id corresponds to a gift card or a non-gift-card method based on the provided context.

predicates.name: gift_card_provided_for_difference
predicates.description: True when the user has provided a gift card specifically to cover the price difference for the current order. This is evidenced by the action arguments indicating that the payment_method_id is a gift card intended to cover the remaining amount due (the price difference) for the order, and the price difference amount is greater than zero.

judge.question: Is the current action using a gift card to cover the remaining amount due for the order, and is the price difference greater than zero?
context: the current action arguments, including payment_method_id and price_difference (and order_id)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Evidence about the gift card condition or the price difference is missing or inconclusive in the action arguments provided.

predicates.name: has_item_ids
predicates.description: The modify action's item_ids argument contains at least one item ID; the action targets modification of one or more existing items in a pending order. If the action is not a modify_pending_order_items action, this predicate is false.

judge.question: Is the current action a modify_pending_order_items action and does its item_ids argument contain at least one item ID?
context: arguments of the current action (including action type and item_ids)
judge.answer_format: yes | no | unknown (unknown -> predicate value None)

unknown_policy_hint.reason: Evidence about the action type or the item_ids list is missing or inconclusive in the current context.

predicates.name: item_change_action
predicates.description: True if the current action changes items in the order, i.e., the action is exchange_delivered_order_items, modify_pending_order_items, or return_delivered_order_items.

judge.question: Is the current action one of: exchange_delivered_order_items, modify_pending_order_items, or return_delivered_order_items?
context: the arguments of the current action (call_args)
